name: Hayashi Yukio
source:
Lives in the room next to the Nonaka couple.
Slovenly unshaven face, carefree hair, it's often think of a vagabond because of his appearance.
The reason for that is because he was fired, his fiance left and he is desperate.
While sick and in this bad lifestyle an unexpected encounter happens.
